This plugin keeps a record of all fish caught by each character and optionally the fish caught at a particular location by any character. It also provides convenient shortcuts to equip your fishing rod and fish and then switch back to your weapon. Basic chat commands: /fl Display fishing proficiency. /fl <link> Display item details. /fl catch List fishing catch records. /fl cook List fish that can be cooked. /fl quest List fish that are part of a quest. /fl trophy List fish that are trophies. /fl track Toggle unknown fish tracking.

Introduction Festival Buddy II is a simple tool to help you keep track of the festivities throughout Middleearth. It is an updated version of the original Festival Buddy by Galuhad. It will display the number of tokens in your wallet when some effects have expired e.g. the treasure chests in the Haunted Barrow and a simple quest guide for those quests that are easily forgotten.
